title: Expected amenable subalgebras preserving core commutants

abstractEnglish: We prove that every inclusion $`N\subset M`$ of von Neumann algebras with separable preduals and a faithful normal conditional expectation contains an expected amenable subalgebra $`P\subset N`$ such that $`P'\cap c(M)=N'\cap c(M)`$, where $`c(M)`$ denotes the continuous core of M. This resolves the relative bicentralizer conjecture in this setting.
